p: Shenzhen Ruoyu Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2023. It is a cutting-edge technology company focused on developing robot brains for embodied AI and applying them to real-world scenarios. It was incubated by Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen). Built on a three-part core architecture of "brain, body, and scenario data," Ruoyu Technology combines the Ruoyu Jiutian robot brain as its core foundation, key carriers of its in-house high-reliability operating hardware such as Ruoyu Lanyue and Ruoyu Zhaixing, and dedicated Ruoyu Tiangong data collection. Together, these form a full-stack embodied AI solution for high-value scenarios.
pc: 深圳若愚科技有限公司成立于2023年，是一家专注于具身智能机器人大脑研发与场景化应用的前沿科技企业，由哈尔滨工业大学(深圳)孵化。若愚科技依托"大脑-本体-场景数据"三位一体核心技术架构，以若愚九天机器人大脑为核心基座，以若愚揽月、若愚摘星等自研高可靠性作业硬件为关键载体，结合若愚天工专属数采，构成高价值场景具身智能全栈解决方案。

pr: Ruoyu Lanyue 01 is the first explosion-proof wheeled humanoid robot in China equipped with a robot brain, and it has been the first to obtain explosion-proof certification for both the complete machine and its collaborative robotic arm. Driven by Ruoyu Jiutian, it can independently complete the entire refueling process. Working with a guidance screen and a mini program, it supports unmanned operations such as automatic guidance, QR-code ordering, and online payment. It offers strong environmental adaptability, resistance to interference in harsh weather, and automatic recharging at low battery, and it can run stably 24/7. It helps gas stations run in a smarter way that is safe, efficient, and economical, and it sets a model for industry applications.
若愚揽月01是国内首款搭载机器人大脑的防爆轮式人形机器人，率先获得整机及协作机械臂防爆认证。在若愚九天驱动下，它可独立完成全套加油流程，并与引导屏、小程序配合实现自动引导、扫码下单和在线支付等无人化操作；具备强环境适应性、恶劣天气抗干扰和低电量自动回充能力，可7*24小时稳定运行，助力加油站安全、高效、经济的智能化运营，树立行业应用范式。
